item.title: Gov. Moore dismisses Trump's "not worthy" snub: "I will bow down to no one"
item.description: Maryland Gov. Wes Moore shrugged off President Trump's claim that he was "not worthy" to attend an annual White House dinner, telling CBS News Mr. Trump does "not determine my worthiness."

item.title: Gov. Moore dismisses Trump's "not worthy" snub: "I will bow down to no one"
item.description: Maryland Gov. Wes Moore told Norah O'Donnell that he "will bow down to no one," dismissing President Trump's decision to exclude him from the annual National Governors Association meeting and dinner at the White House. Watch Moore's full conversation with O'Donnell during a town hall airing Sunday at 8 p.m. ET/PT on CBS.

item.title: 2/12: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: Border czar Tom Homan says ICE surge in Minnesota is ending; House passes rebuke of Canada tariffs, with six Republicans joining Democrats in favor.

item.title: Ruemmler resigning as Goldman Sachs' general counsel after appearing in Epstein files
item.description: Kathryn Ruemmler served as White House counsel under former President Barack Obama.

item.description: The FBI announces new details on masked suspect in Nancy Guthrie case; Border czar Tom Homan says Operation Metro Surge in Minnesota is concluding.

item.title: Another U.S. aircraft carrier expected to head to Middle East, officials say
item.description: The USS Gerald R. Ford aircraft carrier and its escort ships are expected to head to the Middle East, three U.S. officials told CBS News, adding a second aircraft carrier to the region as U.S.-Iran tensions simmer.

item.description: Federal agents clash with protesters day after driver fatally shot by ICE officer in Minneapolis; New book looks at rules for a long and healthy life

item.title: Who Took Our Dad? The Abduction of Ray Wright
item.description: A family man abruptly vanishes. Police tie his disappearance to a monstrous plot for revenge. "48 Hours" contributor Natalie Morales reports.

item.title: Shooting at South Carolina State University leaves 2 dead, 1 wounded
item.description: Two people are dead and another wounded after a shooting in a South Carolina State University residential complex, the school says.

item.title: Where is Jermain Charlo?
item.description: Police release last known images of 23-year-old missing mom. Can this security camera video help reveal what happened to her? "48 Hours" contributor Michelle Miller reports.
